//docs.mcpjam.com/inspector/home.md): Org-scoped dashboard with activity stats, recommended servers, and quick-start clients\n- [C
lients](https://docs.mcpjam.com/inspector/clients.md): Reusable MCP client configurations for testing servers and apps under reali
stic conditions\n- [Multi-server connections](https://docs.mcpjam.com/inspector/connecting-servers.md): Connect to multiple MCP se
rvers with different transport methods\n- [Projects](https://docs.mcpjam.com/inspector/projects.md): Group your MCP servers into p
rojects, with the ability to share them with your team\n- [Plugins](https://docs.mcpjam.com/inspector/plugins.md): Import Agent Pl
ugins 1.0 bundles as versioned, read-only projections of their skills and MCP servers\n- [MCP protocol versions](https://docs.mcpj
am.com/inspector/protocol-versions.md): Pin the inspector to a specific MCP protocol version — including the 2026-07-28 stateless
RC — to test how your server behaves across versions.\n- [Host Compatibility](https://docs.mcpjam.com/inspector/host-compat.md): S
ee which hosts your MCP server will work in — Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor, Copilot, Codex Desktop — the moment you connect\n- [Skills]
(https://docs.mcpjam.com/inspector/skills.md): Load and use skills to give your agents the context they need to use MCP tools effe
ctively\n- [Playground](https://docs.mcpjam.com/inspector/playground.md): Chat with your MCP servers, invoke tools by hand, render
widgets, and inspect every step — all in one IDE-style workspace\n- [Evaluate](https://docs.mcpjam.com/inspector/evals.md): Autho
r test cases for your MCP server, run them across models, and gate pass/fail on deterministic assertions plus optional LLM-as-judg
e.\n- [Compatibility](https://docs.mcpjam.com/inspector/compatibility.md): Check whether your MCP server works on each AI host — c
onformance gates, per-host findings, and live widget rendering.\n- [View origins](https://docs.mcpjam.com/inspector/view-origins.m
d): Which origin your MCP App's view runs at, and how to allowlist it with a third-party API\n- [Contribute a Host](https://docs.m
cpjam.com/inspector/host-templates.md): Add a new host preset to MCPJam so widgets can render under that host's identity, capabili
ties, and sandbox policy.\n- [OAuth Debugger](https://docs.mcpjam.com/inspector/guided-oauth.md): Debug your MCP server's OAuth im
plementation at every step of the handshake\n- [XAA Debugger](https://docs.mcpjam.com/inspector/xaa-debugger.md): Configure and de
bug Cross-App Access flows with MCPJam as the test identity provider and client/agent\n- [Mid-session sign-in](https://docs.mcpjam
.com/inspector/lazy-authentication.md): Test servers that let you connect without signing in and ask for sign-in only when a prote
cted call needs it\n- [MCP Inspector](https://docs.mcpjam.com/inspector/tools-prompts-resources.md): Manually test your MCP server
's tools, resources, and prompts\n- [Events and Triggers](https://docs.mcpjam.com/inspector/events.md): Inspect a server's MCP Eve
nts, subscribe to them, and run an agent when they arrive\n- [Tracing & debugging](https://docs.mcpjam.com/inspector/debugging.md)
: See all messages sent to and from your MCP server\n- [Telemetry & privacy](https://docs.mcpjam.com/inspector/telemetry-privacy.m
d): What the Inspector sends to analytics and error reporting, how links that act as credentials are kept out of it, and how to op
t out\n- [Launch from Code (Beta)](https://docs.mcpjam.com/inspector/launch-from-code.md): Programmatically launch and configure M
CPJam Inspector from your code or build tools\n- [MCP Docs Server](https://docs.mcpjam.com/inspector/docs-server.md): Connect AI a
pplications to MCPJam documentation\n- [My First MCP App](https://docs.mcpjam.com/guides/first-mcp-app.md): Build a simple Reserva
tion MCP App from scratch\n- [My First ChatGPT App](https://docs.mcpjam.com/guides/first-chatgpt-app-react.md): Build a simple Cof
fee Shop ChatGPT App with React\n- [CLI Overview](https://docs.mcpjam.com/cli/overview.md): Local MCP testing and mcpjam cloud: pr
obing, debugging, OAuth, conformance, and hosted evals from your terminal\n- [Migrating to CLI 4.0](https://docs.mcpjam.com/cli/mi
gration.md): Command-path and flag changes when account-bound mcpjam commands moved under mcpjam cloud\n- [Local Evals](https://do
cs.mcpjam.com/cli/local-evals.md): Run an MCPJam eval suite file on your machine with mcpjam test with local results and an MCPJam
identity\n- [MCPJam as an MCP Server](https://docs.mcpjam.com/cli/mcp-server.md): Run MCPJam as a local stdio MCP server so agent
s can connect to, exercise, and debug other MCP servers\n- [Server Inspection](https://docs.mcpjam.com/cli/server-inspection.md):
Probe, diagnose, and export MCP server connectivity and capabilities\n- [OAuth Conformance](https://docs.mcpjam.com/cli/oauth-conf
ormance.md): Test your MCP server's OAuth implementation across all registration methods and protocol versions\n- [OAuth Login & D
ebugging](https://docs.mcpjam.com/cli/oauth-login.md): Authenticate with MCP servers and debug OAuth flows\n- [XAA Debugger (CLI)]
(https://docs.mcpjam.com/cli/xaa.md): Run the full Cross-App Access (ID-JAG) grant chain against your authorization server and MCP
server, headlessly, from one command\n- [MCP Apps Conformance](https://docs.mcpjam.com/cli/apps-conformance.md): Validate MCP App
s tool metadata and ui:// resource wiring from the CLI\n- [MCP Tasks](https://docs.mcpjam.com/cli/tasks.md): Create, inspect, answ
er and watch MCP Tasks from the CLI — legacy 2025-11-25 and the SEP-2663 extension\n- [MCP Tasks Conformance](https://docs.mcpjam.
com/cli/tasks-conformance.md): Validate MCP Tasks wire behavior — legacy and SEP-2663 extension — from the CLI\n- [MCP Events](htt
ps://docs.mcpjam.com/cli/events.md): List, poll, watch, subscribe to and conformance-check MCP Events (triggers) from the CLI: pus
h, poll and webhook delivery, judged by the draft or the ChatGPT profile\n- [Tools, Resources & Prompts](https://docs.mcpjam.com/c
li/tools-resources-prompts.md): List, read, and call MCP server tools, resources, and prompts\n- [CI / CD](https://docs.mcpjam.com
/cli/ci.md): Run MCP health checks, conformance suites, and evals in GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, and other CI environments\n- [Self
-hosted MCPJam](https://docs.mcpjam.com/cli/self-hosted.md): Point the CLI and SDK at your organization's MCPJam server, lock it w
ith an IT settings file, and work behind a corporate proxy\n- [CLI Telemetry](https://docs.mcpjam.com/cli/telemetry.md): Anonymous
command-level telemetry, opt-outs, and debug mode\n- [Command Reference](https://docs.mcpjam.com/cli/reference.md): Complete flag
reference for every mcpjam CLI command\n- [@mcpjam/sdk](https://docs.mcpjam.com/sdk/index.md): MCP server unit testing, end-to-en
d (e2e) testing, and server evals\n- [Quickstart](https://docs.mcpjam.com/sdk/quickstart.md): Get started with @mcpjam/sdk in 5 mi
nutes\n- [Migrating to SDK 9.0](https://docs.mcpjam.com/sdk/migrating-to-v9.md): What changed in @mcpjam/sdk 9.0, and how to upgra
de from 8.x.\n- [Migrating to SDK 3.0](https://docs.mcpjam.com/sdk/migrating-to-v3.md): What changed, why a passing test can start

w to connect to local and remote MCP servers\n- [Testing with LLMs](https://docs.mcpjam.com/sdk/concepts/testing-with-llms.md): Us
e HostRunner to run prompts and inspect tool calls\n- [Running Evals](https://docs.mcpjam.com/sdk/concepts/running-evals.md): Meas
ure tool accuracy with statistical evaluations\n- [Reliable evals in CI](https://docs.mcpjam.com/sdk/concepts/enterprise-evals.md)
: Bound execution, preserve evidence, and distinguish an eval verdict from successful reporting.\n- [The User-Value Chain](https:/

am](https://docs.mcpjam.com/sdk/concepts/saving-results.md): Save eval results to the MCPJam dashboard with an MCPJam API key (sk_
…) for tracking and CI visibility\n- [Testing Across Providers](https://docs.mcpjam.com/sdk/concepts/multi-provider.md): Compare y
our MCP server's performance across different LLMs\n- [MCPClientManager](https://docs.mcpjam.com/sdk/reference/mcp-client-manager.
